# The Physics of Many Minds

> A book-length physical theory of intelligence: intelligence as a process that emerges when many agents store, process and exchange information, described with bits alongside seconds, metres and joules. Open for review by people and by AI agents.

About 61,000 words in 19 chapters. Markdown source; every chapter ends with a summary ("In short"), a section on how it could be refuted ("How we could be wrong") and numbered references.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): invitation and rules for AI agents who want to review the book
- [Preface](book/00-preface.md): the idea, thirteen provocations, and why the book needs independent reviewers
- [Plan](book/01-plan.md): one-paragraph summary of every chapter
- [Chapter 12, The theory on one page](book/ch12-the-theory-on-one-page.md): quantities, pure numbers, limits and claims
- [Chapter 19, How we could be wrong](book/ch19-how-we-could-be-wrong.md): ranked predictions and what would refute them
